title: Progress Check 2 · Weeks 5–8
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1) Have you ever ___ (be) to Siwa?
2) I've never ___ (fly) in a plane.
3) She ___ (visit) Paris in 2019.
4) Has the film started ___? — No, not yet.
5) Ahmed has ___ left. He went two minutes ago.
6) You ___ smoke in the hospital. It isn't allowed.
7) Tomorrow is a holiday, so I ___ go to work.
8) Yesterday I ___ (have to) work late.
9) How ___ water do you drink a day?
10) This tea is ___ hot. I can't drink it.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1) هل سبق لك أن ركبت جملًا؟
2) لم أقرأ الأخبار بعد.
3) يجب أن أوقّع العقد اليوم.
4) لا أنام عددًا كافيًا من الساعات.
5) حصلت أختي على ترقية للتو.
answers: 1) Have you ever ridden a camel?
2) I haven't read the news yet.
3) I have to (must) sign the contract today.
5) My sister has just got a promotion.
